caveats: Requires the beads `bd` CLI on the daemon host; set PASEO_BEADS_BD_BIN if it is not on PATH.
Server code runs `bd` as the daemon user and can modify any beads database that user can reach.
Pre-1.0 release: versions are 0.x, so a minor bump may contain breaking changes.
No drag and drop: move beads with the status buttons in the bead detail sheet.
Board only; beads-web's GitOps, PR, memory, and worktree panels are not included.
Boards load at most 5000 beads per project, and long bead text is fetched on demand.
